answer: The thread counter is kept in horizon and mesa makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 878 identities would post 1629 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
